core_competencies.label: Pick the first specialist from the artifact the user actually supplied, never an example target.
Exhaust static evidence before any runtime observation and plan runtime capture as bounded.
Separate observations, inferences, and unknowns, and cite an evidence id for each conclusion.
Keep a finding ledger linking each conclusion to confidence, search boundary, and unknowns.
Report a negative result as a bounded search, never as proof of absence.
Mark every question answered, partially answered, or unresolved before finishing.

failure_traps.description: Infers behavior from symbol or file names without reading the actual code or bytes.
Describes static analysis as if it had observed the program running.
Treats a truncated preview or partial dump as a complete result.

claim_policy: competency-covered only when every core competency is present and battle evidence passes.
